newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola sees worldwide case volume rising.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola sees worldwide case volume rising.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said Thursday that it expects worldwide unit case volume to increase by about 10 percent in the fourth quarter.
For the full year, the company said it expects worldwide unit case volume to rise by about eight percent.

The company's estimates placed its Latin American Group leading the growth with a 14 to 15 percent increase in fourth quarter unit case volume, followed by a 12 to 13 percent increase in the Africa Group.
Fourth quarter unit case volume should increase five to six percent in the North America Group, 10 to 11 percent in Greater Europe and 11 to 12 percent in the Middle and Far East, the company said.
Coca-Cola said worldwide gallon sales should rise 11 to 12 percent for the quarter and about seven percent for the year.
